sample_unit: AI-generated responses to pneumonia cases (50 cases in triplicate)

links.outcome: Inter-rater reliability (Krippendorff's Alpha) of expert-panel grading rubric applied to AI medication management outputs
links.effect: Alpha was highest in the medication therapy problem and medication therapy format categories across 150 rated outputs; values for other categories were lower and the authors state further analysis beyond pilot testing is needed.
links.quote: The Krippendorffs Alpha was highest in the medication therapy problem and medication therapy format categories, for 50 pneumonia cases, run in triplicate (150 total).

unlisted_practices: Absolute failure criteria: any hallucination or high-harm error fails an AI output regardless of its overall score
Grading framework with a preference dimension that allows for acceptable practice variation in medication management

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates the reliability of a context-of-use evaluation framework/rubric for generative and agentic AI on simulated medication management cases, rather than testing the impact of a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
